title: Product launch reel
description: A short product-focused launch video with a clear opening, detail shots and a polished ending.

scenes.title: Opening hero frame
scenes.imagePrompt: Create a clean hero frame featuring the supplied product exactly as it is. Keep its design unchanged and use a premium uncluttered studio setting.
scenes.videoPrompt: Begin with the product already in frame. Let soft studio light reveal its surface while the background remains calm. Keep the product design perfectly consistent.
scenes.subjectMovement: The product remains stationary; only subtle light reflections change.

scenes.title: Product detail shot
scenes.imagePrompt: Create a close-up reference showing the product's real material, finish and details without modifying any feature.
scenes.videoPrompt: Move into a close-up view and reveal the product details with realistic reflections and smooth motion. No morphing or redesign.
scenes.subjectMovement: No product movement; preserve exact shape and details.

scenes.title: Final presentation
scenes.imagePrompt: Create a final premium product composition with generous negative space for optional campaign text.
scenes.videoPrompt: Ease into the final hero composition and hold the product clearly in focus for the closing moment.
scenes.cameraMovement: Gentle pull-back followed by a steady hold.
